subject.title: feat(models): make per-agent model allowlist explicit; aliases/defaults no longer restrict

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `agents.defaults.modelPolicy.allow` and `agents.list[].modelPolicy.allow` as the public replacement for the historical model-map allowlist semantics, with marker-gated migration of existing default maps?
rationale: This is a new persistent configuration and authorization contract whose upgrade semantics cannot be resolved mechanically from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt explicit policy migration
options.body: Accept `modelPolicy.allow` as the canonical override restriction after final-head live upgrade proof confirms legacy restrictions are preserved.

options.title: Preserve current combined model-map contract
options.body: Keep existing model-map allowlist semantics and pursue a narrower UX repair that does not add a new public policy surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit policy migration
recommendation.body: Accept `modelPolicy.allow` as the canonical override restriction after final-head live upgrade proof confirms legacy restrictions are preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch and current model-config documentation history make this the strongest available routing candidate for the policy decision.
